parameters.query:
INSERT INTO households (household_id_hash, profile_json, location_district, consent_ledger_json, sync_status, last_updated_ts)
VALUES (
  '{{$json.profile.household_id_hash}}',
  '{{JSON.stringify($json.profile.profile_json)}}'::jsonb,
  '{{$json.profile.location_district}}',
  '{{JSON.stringify($json.profile.consent_ledger_json)}}'::jsonb,
  '{{$json.profile.sync_status}}',
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (household_id_hash) DO UPDATE
SET profile_json = EXCLUDED.profile_json,
    last_updated_ts = NOW()
RETURNING household_id_hash;

INSERT INTO audit_ledger (event_type, entity_type, entity_id, actor_id, payload, created_at)
VALUES (
  'voice_query_processed',
  'household',
  '{{$('validate-voice-input').item.json.call_id}}',
  'ultravox_agent',
  '{{JSON.stringify({
    transcript: $('validate-voice-input').item.json.transcript,
    language: $('validate-voice-input').item.json.language,
    query_type: $('validate-voice-input').item.json.query_type,
    schemes_found: ($('merge-results').item.json.schemes || []).length
  })}}'::jsonb,
  NOW()
);
